英文法規名稱: Standards for the Tolerance of Atomic Dust and Radioactivity Contamination in Foods
中文法規名稱: 食品中原子塵或放射能污染容許量標準
沿革內容:
1.DOH Food No0970404024 Announced, July 1, 2008
2.MOHW Food No.1021350146 Amended, August 20, 2013
3.MOHW Food No 1041304620 Amended, January 18, 2016

法規內容.條文內容: The Standards are prescribed in accordance with the provisions of Paragraph 2 of Article 15 of the Act Governing Food Safety and Sanitation.
The tolerances of atomic dust and radioactivity contamination in foods:
The Standards shall be implemented on the date of promulgation.
